verified_scope: Independent read-only verification of prepared release metadata, exact retained source/static payload inventories and production-relative content scope. No deployment or hosted polling performed.

source_snapshot.retention: Exact snapshot exists locally at official app path; off-device backup and byte-identical rebuild are unverified.

preview.qualification: Deployment identity supplied by parent; no live state queried in this audit. Hosted preview, browser, staged-production and anonymous-production gates are separate and not certified by this receipt.

research_qualifications: Saved descriptive numerical results imported from tv-indicators; Abacus did not rerun EMA reconstruction, market event outcomes, native TradingView verification or original research checks.
Sixty-four shared U.S. release timestamps across six currency futures; native57 is a separate shorter cohort and is not pooled. Cross-currency shocks and overlapping windows limit independence.

A completed 15-minute candle ending at the release supplies benchmark close and frozen EMA20/50 direction; the candle opening at the release is the first measured candle. H5/H10/H15/H50/H100 count actual subsequent chart candles, not fixed elapsed time.

Corrected historical calendar is not an as-announced point-in-time vintage. Available history and event eligibility are retrospective; reconstructed EMA history and back-adjusted continuous prices are analytical inputs.
Original source validation receipts are preserved imported evidence; exact-byte and publication-transfer checks do not repeat those numerical validations or establish research validity.
No commissions, spread, slippage, financing, targets, stops, sizing or executable-fill model. Ticks differ across instruments and are not dollar P&L; MFE/MAE is an excursion ratio, not profit factor.

No supplied confidence intervals, independent holdout, multiple-comparison adjustment or event-causality design. Positive sample averages do not establish executable strategy or future profitability; negative/inconclusive outcomes remain visible.
Default workspace gate retains two existing Bhishma input prerequisites after 226 tests; four later default checks were unexecuted. Selected app/source checks are separate.
limitations: All findings concern prepared local bytes and retained records. Hosted availability, browser layout/interactions and production promotion require separately completed gates.
Historical private audit receipts preserve their original qualifications; this independent scope audit does not scientifically revalidate prior studies.
